model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis (ranging from 0.0 to 0.4) as a function of steps on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 500). The Llama-On-Policy-Easy model (green line) starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and steadily increases to around 0.35, exhibiting a smooth upward trend with minor fluctuations. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model (red line) follows a similar trajectory, starting near 0.0 and rising to about 0.38, with more pronounced oscillations throughout the training process. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," displays training rewards on the y-axis (ranging from 0.0 to 0.2) against steps on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 500). The Llama-On-Policy-Hard model (blue line) begins at a reward of approximately 0.0 and increases slightly to around 0.02, showing a very slow and nearly flat learning curve. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model (orange line) starts at a reward of about 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.2, with a steeper initial increase and more significant fluctuations compared to the Llama-On-Policy-Hard model.
